page.layout: One page of text, running head at top with page number left; a woodcut engraving in the lower middle with a caption printed across its top. Faint show-through text below the engraving is not transcribed.

main_text.p: re possumus ) quoniam Latinis cum Græcis per omnia communes sunt: peculiaribus hîc præceptis nihil indigere videntur.
Exempla igitur, usui quotidiano cognoscenda relinquimus.]
Atque hîc quoque finis Græcæ Grammaticæ esto.

page.notes: The caption above the woodcut is printed in italic across the top of the engraving and is transcribed as a paragraph. The engraving itself (a stylised figure with rays and foliage) is not text. Show-through from the reverse page is ignored. The caption's letters partly overlap the engraving and "Græcæ" and "Gram-" are read with some uncertainty; "Grammaticæ" is marked as possibly misread in its second part.
